description:
## What to do

Adapt the upstream session format doc (tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/session.md) for our Elixir system.

## Upstream source

- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/docs/session.md
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/coding-agent/src/core/messages.ts
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/ai/src/types.ts
- tmp/pi-mono/packages/agent/src/types.ts

## Output

Create docs/session.md

## How to adapt

1. **File Location**: Update from `~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<path>--/<timestamp>_<uuid>.jsonl` to our path. Check where we actually store sessions (likely `~/.octo_pi/sessions/`).

2. **Session Version**: We are at v3 (same as upstream). Document the migration path:
   - Version 1: Linear entry sequence (legacy, auto-migrated)
   - Version 2: Tree structure with id/parentId
   - Version 3: Renamed hookMessage role to custom
   - Note our `OctoPi.Coder.SessionStore` handles migrations.

3. **Message Types**: Convert all TypeScript interfaces to Elixir structs:
   - `TextContent` → `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Message.TextContent`
   - `ImageContent` → `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Message.ImageContent`
   - `ThinkingContent` → `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Message.ThinkingContent`
   - `ToolCall` → `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Message.ToolCall`
   - `UserMessage` → `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Message.UserMessage`
   - `AssistantMessage` → `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Message.AssistantMessage`
   - `ToolResultMessage` → `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Message.ToolResultMessage`

4. **Session Header**: Show our `OctoPi.Coder.SessionEntry.Header` struct with all fields.

5. **Tree structure**: The id/parentId linking is the same. Show our `OctoPi.Coder.SessionManager` tree API.

6. **Entry types**: Document all our SessionEntry subtypes:
   - `:header`, `:user_message`, `:assistant_message`, `:tool_result`
   - `:compaction`, `:branch_summary`
   - `:custom`, `:custom_message`, `:label`, `:model_change`, `:thinking_level_change`
   - `:passthrough`, `:session_info`, `:branch_summary_message`, `:compaction_summary_message`

## What to preserve verbatim

- The JSONL format explanation
- The tree structure concept (id/parentId)
- The migration logic (v1 → v2 → v3)
- The content block type definitions (text, image, thinking, toolCall)

## Key upstream references to include

- [session-manager.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/session-manager.ts)
- [messages.ts](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/coding-agent/src/core/messages.ts)
- [types.ts (ai)](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/ai/src/types.ts)
- [types.ts (agent)](https://github.com/badlogic/pi-mono/blob/main/packages/agent/src/types.ts)

## Testing the doc

After writing, verify:
1. All struct names match our actual modules
2. All field names match (snake_case in Elixir vs camelCase in TS)
3. The entry type atoms are correct
4. The session header fields are complete
